scope: R14-B complete local contracts of sixteen directly anchored Db_files.cpp wrappers; static evidence only

native_comparison.procedure: independent original-byte Capstone decode, address and normalized mnemonic/operand equality for every owned instruction; private asm/c/refs files verified against pinned manifest; decompiler inspected as secondary interpretation

abi.calling_convention: cdecl supported by four stack arguments, plain RET and internal argument cleanup; no ECX receiver

shared_normal_contract.direction_basis: R09 helper body inspection plus freshly decoded destination-store/copy/delegation sites; no write helper used by a direct branch
shared_normal_contract.return: direct paths compare saved original count; zero count can satisfy equality without a transfer
shared_normal_contract.failure: short count returns 0 without rollback; partial destination/stream effects possible
shared_normal_contract.validation_limits: No destination capacity/null check, descriptor null check, count bounds, record-content check or complete schema

shared_error_contract.termination_dependency: R09 resolves 00945934 machinery to ExitProcess import at00967164; current decode includes009459e7

functions.direct_return: EAX exactly 0 or 1 according to helper EAX == original_count

error.effect: shared diagnostic and termination(-1); no normal false return

coverage_summary.reason: All local paths, ABI, guards, call marshalling, local writes and return handling are mapped; delegated body semantics remain explicitly outside each local contract

uncertainties: No semantic record types or fields except literal post-read WORD predicate are established
Descriptor+0x3f meaning remains opaque; descriptor==1/2 are raw values
Delegated helpers have field-read entry boundaries, but full conversion effects, source layouts, total on-disk widths and rollback behavior remain unresolved
Caller allocation owner, destination capacity/lifetime and complete database/save schema remain unresolved
Native incoming references are discovered direct-call inventory, not runtime reachability or proof against indirect callers
No RNG restore/persistence or game-wide determinism claim; no execution oracle or behavior port added
